ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a "schematic diagram of the route of the Anhui Electricity Eastward Transmission Project"; the transmission line starts from near Huainan within Anhui Province, goes eastward past the Yangtze River and in the direction of Jiangsu Province, and connects to Shanghai and other places; the diagram also marks information about the total length of the line and the amount of electricity transmitted each year after completion. Then reason: Huainan is an important coal base in China, and the Anhui Electricity Eastward Transmission Project mainly relies on the abundant coal resources in places such as Huainan, Anhui, to generate thermal power, and then transmits the electricity to Shanghai and other Yangtze River Delta areas. Therefore, the electricity transmitted by this project is electricity with coal as the main energy source.
